framing: Final native portrait shows full tail and body. Browser per-asset camera -31deg/80deg/85% reveals tail; previous camera evidence preserved.
identity: Same green scaled dragon, orange horns/spines, amber eyes, cream belly, two wings and long tail across native samples and browser. No texture/shape replacement between states.
limitations: Coarse/faceted scales and silhouette remain visible close up; 4K texture is not Muse-quality equivalence.
No blink, mouth, finger, walk or flight-control delivery.
Arms/legs have bones but broad articulation is not accepted; delivered clips leave arm/foot rotations at rest.
Endpoint pixels match, but loop velocity and visual seamlessness are not certified.
No Weft mapping or physics alignment.
portrait_filter: Local OIDN-filtered portrait accepted for presentation; raw portrait preserved. Filtering softens sampling noise, not geometry defects.
rejected_attempts: finished-v2: raised-arm celebration pulled belly geometry

states.idle: Subtle body/head motion and tail sway; not a repeated still.
states.look_around: Clear side-to-side head inspection with tilt, tail response and stationary feet.
states.milestone_level_up: Small bow/head lift with wing and tail flourish. Revised pose avoids the rejected arm-raised belly pull.
states.wing_flap: Wings move through three flaps without pulling head/feet in sampled poses; standing, not flight.
